a.text: 'Life'. A concept so vague, yet so fascinating.
We've gotten used to treating any individual that thinks like us as life, for no other reason than the fact that they're like us.
For no other reason than that we all fight death to the bitter end for our own survival.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Target eliminated.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Stormeye. Four o'clock. Two-round burst fire.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: At the wall supports?
Stormeye is confused, but fires two arrows in rapid succession without hesitation.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: The environment changed the instant I fired! The obstacle disappeared, and the rounds hit the enemy...

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: How did you do that?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It wasn't me. It was ZOOT who did the calculations.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now, jump down at your six o'clock. Don't worry about the Originium shards in the hole.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Hah.
He jumps, and his surroundings change again, causing him to fall endlessly, until his fall is arrested by a rope of incantations.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Closure's calculations were spot-on.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I've been waiting here.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Follow instructions and go in with eyes shut.

a.text: We praise the courage of struggle and celebrate the virtue of defiance.
And so the lives that follow the same way of thinking join the procession of slim hope.
Our struggle must seem utterly insignificant to It.
Perhaps It never even took notice.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: All hostiles in sight have been eliminated.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Quarantine zone line of defense established.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Good job, kitten!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Shame you didn't leave a few for me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's next, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thirty seconds.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The next wave of enemies will appear at twelve o'clock. Eliminate with extreme prejudice.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It will open a path to the route that the Doctor must take.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Good! More pain for the culprit.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How about I get first dibs this time, kitten?

a.text: You don't agree with me, do you, {@nickname}?
There is no certainty that this is the key to the truth. But, after ascertaining that the foreseen despair will destroy all that we worked for—
We must grasp what hope we can reach in our hands.
I have poured too much love into the miracle of life, that I see ever more clearly the weakness and flaws that we cannot cast aside.
How do I trust everyone whom I love? How do I trust... you?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Closure! It's not working!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The surrounding structures are beginning to contract! They're trying to crush me!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The drones I sent out aren't finding any viable routes. The reinforced supports won't last long.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm working on it!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ZOOT is trying to process a LOT of data simultaneously. Give her some time!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Six, five, four, three, two... one!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Mechanist! Look up!
In the shadow, the ceiling begins to warp, then a cold blade cuts open a path leading to the unknown.
A hand emerges from the gap.

steps.name: Misery's Voice
steps.text: Someone said you needed a hand?

steps.name: Misery's Voice
steps.text: As they say, extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures.

steps.name: Misery's Voice
steps.text: Hang on tight, Mechanist!

steps.name: Misery's Voice
steps.text: Everyone's waiting for you.

a.text: I cannot accurately predict when we will meet again—
But I am certain that when that time comes, we will have lost all that we have now.
No life can defy death forever, and those who have passed do not meet again at the end of time.
But I hope that I will see you again there... {@nickname}.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Angry roar)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Charges energy)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Fires an energy beam)
The beam burns a massive hole through the blockade of Originium entities, raking its way into the distance, cutting the entities down in swathes—
Then, it is stopped by some kind of force.
Good hit, good hit!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Just be careful you don't hit the Doctor, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: We're in position.
You lead the team out of the darkness.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Shakes body in joy)

options: Neutralize all enemies around the Sarcophagus.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Coordinate with me.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Incantations with you.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Is that the Sarcophagus? It was hidden inside the ship all along?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit's signal is weakening!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We have to get inside.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Is Kal'tsit in there?

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: It's not looking good for her, based on what Raidian said.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We need to get her out of there ASAP, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm worried for her safety, if we delay any longer.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: We can't act rashly. We don't know what the situation is with Kal'tsit and the Sarcophagus.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Combat logs indicate that someone came into contact with the Sarcophagus in Chernobog, causing a reaction that nobody expected.
You walk towards the Sarcophagus without hesitation.
You touch the cold Sarcophagus... it answers.
No, Kal'tsit answers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit—

steps.name: Weak Voice
steps.text: You've come at a good time.

steps.name: Weak Voice
steps.text: What's the situation... of Rhodes Island...?
You extend your hand to the one in the Sarcophagus.
She takes your hand. You have never felt such weakness from her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't worry about me...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It wasn't easy, trying to access PRTS through the Sarcophagus. But I did find a surprising gift.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll share more information about PRTS and Priestess with you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Anxious howl)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't worry, Mon3tr. I'm still standing before you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't abandon you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've located a path into the Abyss, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's time we put an end to this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The interference is strong here. We're very close to the Abyss.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But there is no path. The Abyss has completely concealed itself—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can pinpoint its precise location at this range.
Standing before the wall in the deepest reaches, Kal'tsit takes a deep breath.
She has never been this far in—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Anxious growl)
You walk to Kal'tsit's side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm with you too, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe... things will be different this time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have retained certain permissions by way of the Sarcophagus. I'll open a path.
Kal'tsit touches the wall that separates you and the Abyss.

a.text: Warning: Insufficient engine power. Engines shutting down.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: 'Zeroth Order Oil Tank'... thank you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The ship has stopped.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Protect the Doctor, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: From this point on, act according to your own discretion based on the Doctor's condition. You must protect the Doctor from unknown threats...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...And protect the Doctor from the Doctor, if it comes to that.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Growl of trust)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keep a close eye on the condition of Dr. {@nickname}, Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The rules we think we know about reality do not necessarily apply inside the Abyss.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Danger is everywhere, but your safety and that of the Doctor are the highest priority at all times. You are the only ones who can face the ultimate threat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... I'll be careful.

options: Anything else I need to know?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Trust your heart.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I never thought this would come so soon, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But our experiences in the Assimilated Universe and in Trimounts have made me rethink. You have shown me a different possibility.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whatever happens from this point on is a complete unknown, to you, to me, and to everyone else on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I need to hear it from you, Dr.{@nickname}—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Will you still hesitate in the face of possible danger?

options: But it's not the danger in front of me that I'm worried about.
You're still trying to hide your own anxiety and uncertainty, Kal'tsit.
You don't need to carry everything on your shoulders.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Pokes Kal'tsit in agreement)

options: This time, Rhodes Island and I stand with you.
I am not worried about the danger before me, for I am with you. All of you.
You have been on edge ever since we entered this area.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Uneasy growl)

options: Rhodes Island and I are with you. Trust us.
Tell me what I need to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've awakened the program that opens up the Abyss. The energy required to open up the compartment is ready.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I do not have full permission to access the Abyss.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Should we smash our way in, then? Maybe Misery can think of a way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There might not be another place more concealed, more secured than the Abyss in all of Terra. Only one person has the permission to access it.
You feel Kal'tsit's gaze upon you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Most of Rhodes Island's structure was badly damaged when I finally found it, seventeen years ago.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only the Abyss and its surrounding areas remain completely intact.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The unknown energy within the Abyss continued to power PRTS, becoming the framework of the command system that we came to rely on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But no one had accessed the Abyss... not in over ten thousand years.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Three years ago, when Amnannam fully descended, I began to realize that the crisis was progressing faster than I had expected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Many of us witnessed the chaos firsthand. We still feel sorrow and regret vividly.
Ascalon raises her blade silently, on guard against any sudden threats.
Sensing Ascalon's tension, Raidian calms her and everyone else present with her Originium Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For three years, we have strengthened Rhodes Island's defenses, simulating threats that attempt to destroy Rhodes Island from within.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was through the joint effort of all our operators that we managed to quickly identify the source of the crisis when it occurred.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But we are now at the edge of the fog. Take one step further, and we step into the unknown.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once, I hesitated. But the Doctor is right. We will overcome this crisis, as we have done so many times.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For we are together.
Logos's bone pen draws through the air, the words coming out of his mouth, and the blessings soon after.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It's been a long time since we worked together so in sync, Logos. How are you feeling?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Focused.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Based on available information, there are more than just the core parts of PRTS in the Abyss.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: An entity by the name of 'Priestess' may be sleeping in a Sarcophagus within.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Priestess wakes up, she must be neutralized ASAP with the full force of all present.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is the best way to prevent any mishap, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The moment of her awakening will be her weakest... it will take time for her to adapt to her surroundings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...?
You touch the wall in front of you. The strange sensation causes your heart to race.
You have the feeling that this place was waiting for you... that you are the reason for its existence to begin with.
The wall trembles. You seem to hear blaring sirens that threaten to burst your eardrums.
For an instant, you fall into a trance. Does the cacophony come from the present, or the past?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Abyss is changing!
The wall begins to move irregularly, creating a rift.
Air gushes out from the rift.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Veil.'
The Banshee's incantation forms an invisible barrier that stops the gushing jet.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Step back, Doctor.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Everyone, on guard.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (High-pitched howl)

a.text: ...I never thought I would be the one who didn't want to let go.

steps.text: Pink threads rise from her staff. The Black Crown appears above her head.
You hear Mantra's voice in your mind—

a.text: If you need any help, just give a thought. We're here.
How about you cover my flank, Sharp?
Then make sure you hold your bow tight.
I am sure that the connection between us will transcend even time and space, Dr. {@nickname}.
I am sure we will meet again. At the far end of our civilization, once adorned by darkness and the brilliance of the stars up above, we will meet once again.
I will wait for that day.
Give a holler if you need help, kitten!
Our Arts are being suppressed by the environment, but the Originium Arc seems to work.
I can go in first to check things out—
But that makes me even more worried.
Get ready, folks. The fate of Rhodes Island is in our hands.

steps.text: You step into the space within the rift.

a.text: <color=#000000>I will wait until that day comes. I promise you I will. Wait for me.</color>

<color=#000000>

You must wait for me too.</color>
